messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: `release/redwood-core v2.14.0` -> prod
Canary: 5% for 10m. Change window: 2026-04-05 22:00 UTC - 23:30 UTC. Rollback CLI: `/ops rollback release/redwood-core@v2.14.0` :robot_face:

alexa: Quick coord - I drafted the internal announce. Need pin decision and confirm who posts it.

samir: Sharing release notes snippet below, pls edit. I'll push the final RN to the docs repo once we agree.

samir:
```
Release v2.14.0
- runtime: improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency by ~12%
- api: added `streaming_chunk_size` config for large responses
- infra: better fallback routing for model variants
Notes: No schema changes. Backwards-compatible.
```

ryan: @alexa I can post the internal announce. Will do 15m before the change window unless you want earlier.

alexa: Please post at -15. Include the canary/rollback steps and the sneak peek RN snippet. Add a note to ping platforms-oncall if errors spike.

lena: Rollback thresholds proposal: 5xx rate >1% sustained for 3m OR p50 latency increase >200ms vs baseline for 5m -> rollback. Also watch `model-fallback` errors.

samir: We'll pin model sha for prod: `model-redwood/open-quant@sha256:7a9c...` and include a fallback to smaller quant variant. Canary will route 3 regions (us, eu, apac) at 5% each.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> prod canary pool. Monitoring hooks enabled. :rocket:

alexa: Awesome. Ryan, include this exact rollback wording and monitoring links (console -> releases -> v2.14.0) in the announce.

ryan: Got it. I'll paste the RN snippet, rollback thresholds, and the console link. Want me to @platforms-oncall now or only if alert fires?

lena: Only if alert fires. We'll have quiet watches until +30m after full rollout.

samir: One more ask - QA found a minor logging spam but not release-blocking; I'll include the debug flag we cleaned up in the RN notes.

alexa: OK. Final checklist: pin model sha (samir), post internal announce -15m (ryan), monitor thresholds (lena), ready to rollback CLI (oncall). If canary looks green at +10m we'll proceed to 50% then 100% with the usual 20m ramps.

deploy-bot: Canary pass check (10m): no errors beyond threshold. Ready to ramp on user command. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Posting announce now (internal). Will paste link here once it's up.

ryan: Internal announce posted: <https://internal.redwood.com/releases/v2.14.0|release v2.14.0 announce> :mega:

alexa: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the external RN draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
